title: Slow World
description: Slows the pace of the world: day–night cycles are 3× longer, item despawn time is extended to 15 minutes, and 3x slower growth and decay.
body:
This datapack slows time progression, item despawn, and natural growth and decay, making the flow of time feel slower and more realistic.

- Day–night cycles are 3x longer (time flows 3x slower)
- Item despawn time is extended to 15 minutes (3x longer than vanilla's 5 minutes)
- Random tick speed is set to 1, making growth and decay 3x slower (slower crop growth, longer leaf decay, etc.)
